description: This file contains data extraction functions for Opik payload building, including functions for normalizing provider names, extracting metadata, span identifiers, tags, applying proxy header overrides, and building comprehensive metadata dictionaries.

methods.name: normalize_provider_name
methods.description: Normalizes LiteLLM provider names to standardized string names.

methods.name: extract_opik_metadata
methods.description: Extracts and merges Opik metadata from request and requester.

methods.name: extract_span_identifiers
methods.description: Extracts trace_id and parent_span_id from span data.

methods.name: extract_tags
methods.description: Builds a list of tags from Opik metadata and optional LLM provider.

methods.name: apply_proxy_header_overrides
methods.description: Overrides project name, tags, and thread ID based on proxy headers.

methods.name: extract_and_build_metadata
methods.description: Constructs a comprehensive metadata dictionary from various sources including Opik, logging, and cost info.
